name: priority-dev-spike
title: The first spikes of priority.dev measure its riskiest unknowns
outcome: On recorded transcripts, priority-dev digests a run with Inkling and interprets it with Nemo into a checked Interpretation or an Abstain. Probes show what the hooks and the pane do. A replay report states the valid-output and quote-found rates, and each injected failure ends as an Abstain.
done_when: a replay over the redacted fixtures writes a report with the valid-output rate, the quote-found rate, the abstain reasons, and the characters, seconds, and cost for each stage
each injected failure (rate limit, malformed JSON, empty quote, timeout) ends as an Abstain with a logged reason
the hook probe and the tmux probe reports state a measured answer for each unknown in adapter-host.md section 7
a Stop event from a scratch session reaches the event log and leads to a stored digest and interpretation
abort_if: Nemo returns valid, grounded output on too few real stops to build on, and Inkling cannot digest either
a hook in a live session cannot be made safe: it blocks the session and the bypass file does not release it

min_work.derived_from: 6 divergent frames, 1 critic, 3 challenges, 1 draft review, 0 colliding ADRs, 1 uncovered path

epics.title: Probes: a model probe, a hook probe, and a tmux probe in a scratch session.
epics.outcome: Each unknown of the model, the hooks, and the pane has a measured answer in a committed report.

epics.title: Interpreter: the stop brief, Triage, Pick, Fill, Card, Digest, and the replay report.
epics.outcome: A replay over the fixtures gives a report, and each injected failure ends as an Abstain with a reason.

epics.title: Event log: Postgres 17 with append, read, ingest, follow, and an interpreter service.
epics.outcome: A run.stopped event in the log leads to a stored digest and interpretation.

epics.title: Adapter to the log: hooks and tail through a spool, a signed send, and an answer from a held hook.
epics.outcome: A real stop reaches the log, and a signed command reaches the pane and is confirmed.
